sexualHistories.name: Awakened
sexualHistories.description: You were once ordinary — until a single, overwhelming sexual experience permanently transformed you. That moment awakened something deep inside your body, mind, and soul.
equipment: Clothing that feels especially good against hypersensitive skin
Small keepsake from the being or event that awakened you

traits: Ordinary sensations feel dull compared to what I now experience.
I am terrified of the being that awoke my sexuality.
I am both fascinated and frightened by my new sensitivity.
I enjoy losing myself completely in the intensity of pleasure.
I want to give others at least a fraction of the otherworldly pleasure I experienced.
My body reacts strongly to stimulation, and I can’t hide it.
My awakening is both a gift and a curse.
I constantly yearn for touch, but I fear how deeply it affects me.

ideals.text: Discovery. I’ve become something different and I must find out what.
Sensation. Life is best lived seeking deeper and more complete sensations.
Control. I must master what I’ve become before it masters me.
Sharing. Everyone should experience what I’ve experienced.
Power. This awakening must be harnessed to elevate me above other mortals.
Acceptance. I must embrace who I am now, no matter the cost.

bonds: I am haunted by the entity that awakened me.
I need to find others that experienced what I did.
I must hide my sexual nature for fear of what people may think.
I owe a debt to the person or people that witnessed my awakening.
I want nothing more than to recreate my awakening moment.
I worry that I am no longer fully mortal.
flaws: I tend to lose sense of reality when experiencing even basic sensations.
I push my body too far just for the sensations.
I am addicted to intense pleasure and will always be chasing the next “high.”
I feel that normal lovers are insufficient for me.
I will let the intensity of my pleasure kill me.
I won’t let anybody see my true nature.

sexualHistories.name: Breeding Stock
sexualHistories.description: You were kept as a source of strong breeding, or sought out for your talents to enrich someone's bloodline with greatness.

traits: I take great pleasure in providing my body to further my bloodline of greatness.
I provide my body for breeding out of necessity, knowing it keeps me safe in some way.
I breed offspring to raise as followers for my grand design.
Breeding is an expression of love for the world, my lover, or my family.
I have no choice. This is my lot. I am resigned to it.
I have a distinct desire to constantly breed, and I can’t control it.
I am very selective in who I breed with. Only the finest mates will do.
Despite my station, I have a deep love interest, and I would only give my body to them if it were possible.

ideals.text: Life. To bring and give life is the ultimate calling.
Family. My body for my family. Nothing else matters.
Influence. The more of my offspring in the world, the more power I will inevitably gain.
Duty. It is my duty to provide life for my family, whether in the bedchamber or the nursery.
Purity. I keep my bloodline pure by ensuring those I breed with are of the highest quality.
Glory. I earned my place as the finest breeding stock in the land, and I will enjoy my reward.

bonds: My position cements my family’s alliance with another.
Nothing is greater to me than my familial duty.
My loyalty to my owner is unwavering.
I will break free from this station, one way or another.
I am in love with someone that I am not permitted to breed with.
I will further my glorious bloodline by any means necessary.
flaws: I hate the process of breeding, despite loving the outcome.
I cannot perform unless I am partially intoxicated.
My self-worth revolves around the number of suitors wanting to breed with me.
I would rather masturbate than be forced to have sex with other people.
My station is shameful in the eyes of those I look up to.
I will never breed with a different species than me for fear of dirtying my bloodline.

sexualHistories.name: Chaste Virgin
sexualHistories.description: You have taken a solemn vow of chastity. Your virginity remains intact while indulging others through teasing, manual, oral, or occasional anal pleasure.

traits: I’m fiercely protective of my chastity, even if it means violence.
I have great pride in maintaining my chastity in a world that gives it away so freely.
I blush and become flustered when sexual topics are broached, but I try to maintain my composure.
I have strong feelings concerning the sanctity of love and relationships, and I judge others strongly based on their feelings thereof.
I’m deeply curious about intimacy and long to discuss it openly.
I idealize romance and sexuality, believing it should be pure and untainted.
I use my limits to tease and titillate others, knowing I’ll never give them what they desire.
I am anxious about physical affection, despite how good it may feel.

ideals.text: Purity. I believe in preserving the body, and thereby the soul, for the right person.
Patience. I want love to come naturally, without rushing into physical affection.
Faith. My faith keeps me grounded and safe from breaking my vow of chastity.
Self-Discipline. I control my desires and actions. Resisting temptation strengthens me.
Temptation. I use my temptation to tempt others, knowing I will never give them what they desire.
Romanticism. I believe in love as something sacred, to be shared only with the perfect companion.

bonds: I am saving myself for the return of my long-lost love.
My chastity is for my deity, and I may never break it for fear of losing my connection to the divine.
My family expects me to remain pure, and I do not want to disappoint them.
I am waiting for someone who will value me for things beyond what my flesh can offer.
I will give my virginity to whomever proves the strongest and most capable.
My chastity is ordained by the church, and only the church can take it from me.
flaws: I am often curious about the feelings I experience when aroused.
I don’t trust the interest others show for me. I believe they only want my body.
I get a thrill showing off for those that want me, knowing I will never give them what they desire.
My taste for intoxicants will likely end my chastity.
I have a hard time connecting with others due to my rigid belief system.
I judge people harshly while also yearning for their personal freedom.

sexualHistories.name: Courtesan
sexualHistories.description: You worked professionally as a companion, rising from dockside work to guild recognition.

features.level3: Guild Contacts & Houses of Ill Repute

traits: I can find something beautiful in everyone.
Every conversation is a performance, and I am always on stage.
I never forget a face—or any body part.
I prefer innuendo to open communication.
My laughter is a shield and refuge.
I collect secrets the way others collect coin.
I dress to be remembered.
I am generous to those who please me and merciless to those who don’t.

ideals.text: Freedom. My body, my rules.
Power. Desire is the true currency of the world.
Beauty. Life is too short for anything less than exquisite.
Sisterhood. Every harlot is kin to me, and I protect my own.
Pleasure. The pursuit of ecstasy is the highest calling.
Redemption. Even the coldest heart can be warmed by the right touch.

bonds: I owe my life to the madam who bought my contract.
A powerful noble keeps my true name in a locked box; I will do anything to retrieve it.
My family needs every coin I earn, and I work hard to support them.
I am secretly in love with a client who can never return my feelings.
I owe the guild too much, and I will be working off my debt until I die.
I seek the one patron who saw the real me beneath the paint and perfume.
flaws: I fall in love far too easily.
I can’t resist a dangerous liaison.
My pride will not let me accept charity, even when I’m starving.
I keep trophies from every lover; some are dangerous to possess.
I am addicted to the thrill of being desired.
I trust nobody.

sexualHistories.name: Cult Seducer
sexualHistories.description: You used sex as a tool to lure, convert, and bind others into a forbidden cult or cause.

traits: My smile is warm; my eyes are hungry.
I always speak as though the listener already belongs to me.
Every secret you tell me becomes a prayer.
I taste forbidden knowledge on everyone’s skin.
My sighs and moans echo with distant chanting when I am aroused.
I collect devotees the way others collect coins.
I never break eye contact during the act.
People say my voice lingers in their dreams for weeks.

ideals.text: Revelation. The truth is only found in surrender.
Dominion. Mortal souls are clay for the chosen.
Transcendence. Pain and pleasure open the same gate.
Obedience. True freedom lies in surrender to one capable of command.
Knowledge. Some truths can only be learned naked and screaming.
Ascension. I will birth a great evil (or great good) with my body.

bonds: My original cult still hunts me for the secrets I stole.
I am bound by blood-oath to a demon I once summoned in ecstasy.
I seek the one acolyte who saw through my lies and embraced the cause…and my flesh.
Secret taboos are etched into my flesh; I want to add more.
I must corrupt or redeem the paladin who once spared my life.
My child was taken by the cult at birth; I will get them back.
flaws: I cannot resist converting those that resist me.
I sometimes speak vile and erotic thoughts, but do not remember them afterward.
Betrayal excites me more than loyalty.
I keep trophies from every soul I break.
I crave the burn of something sacred on my profane flesh.
I’m never sure whether I serve the power or the power serves me.

sexualHistories.name: Erotic Disciple
sexualHistories.description: You dedicated yourself to the disciplined study and practice of erotic arts under a master or tradition.

traits: Intimacy is an art that is best expressed over long periods of time and with great attention to detail.
I treat my body as a sacred vessel, and do the same for my lovers.
I take great pride in being able to provide pleasure to my lovers.
I am patient in all things, especially sex, for the journey is as indulgent and gratifying as the destination.
I attempt to achieve higher states of awareness and enlightenment through pleasure.
I use my sexuality as a means of providing healing, physical and emotional.
I am obsessive about my craft and may spend hours perfecting a single technique on many different lovers.
I surround myself with erotic lore in hopes of finding ancient, forgotten techniques to bring higher states of pleasure to my lovers.

ideals.text: Enlightenment. I believe that pleasure can heal and enlighten those that partake with an uninhibited mind.
Self-Expression. We can most wholly express our innermost self through giving and receiving pleasure.
Healing. Love heals all wounds, whether it is sexual or not.
Patience. To rush through intimacy is to forego the most exquisite of experiences.
Pleasure. Pleasure is nothing to be ashamed of, no matter how you achieve it.
Hedonism. There is nothing more important than the pursuit of pleasure.

bonds: I am happy to teach others my craft, especially if they learn through experience.
I learned the benefits of healing through intimacy from a parental figure that I grew to love as a partner.
My life is a sexual and emotional journey that is a never-ending search for new experiences.
I feel responsible for the sexual journeys of others and eagerly seek to guide anyone on their own quest.
I seek not only personal exploration but social exploration through sexuality.
I long for a partner who yearns for a deeply erotic and personal journey like I do.
flaws: I have been known to neglect other aspects of my life in pursuit of sexual and erotic exploration.
I often feel guilty when I indulge too much in the pleasures of the flesh.
I am overly critical of my partners if I feel they are not as skillful as I am.
I sometimes forget the emotional and spiritual side of sexuality.
I see everything through a lens of sexuality that makes me feel perverse in the eyes of others.
My moral compass is the first sacrifice in my pursuit of novel carnal thrills.

sexualHistories.name: Harem Tender
sexualHistories.description: You served as caretaker, coordinator, or favored intimate within a harem, managing pleasure and harmony among multiple partners.

traits: I read a room’s desires before anyone speaks.
Jealousy is a poison I neutralize with a smile and a touch.
I take quiet pride in making everyone feel like the favorite.
Harmony among lovers is the most beautiful music.
I remember every preference of every lover I’ve tended.
I am discreet to a fault – secrets die with me.
I orchestrate pleasure the way a conductor leads an orchestra.
I find deep satisfaction in service, even when unseen.

ideals.text: Harmony. Many hearts can beat as one with the right guidance.
Pleasure. Everyone deserves to feel desired and satisfied.
Order. A well-run harem is a masterpiece of civilization.
Devotion. True loyalty is shown through care for all, not just one.
Excess. Why choose one when many can share bliss?
Power. Controlling desire is the ultimate control.

bonds: The sovereign I once served still holds my heart – or my contract.
I swore to protect the other members of my former harem with my life.
A rival tender seeks to ruin my reputation out of jealousy.
I search for the one lover who saw me as more than a servant.
My current patron demands absolute exclusivity – a vow I struggle to keep.
I owe a life-debt to the harem that raised and trained me.
flaws: I become anxious when attention is focused on only one person.
I manipulate emotions without realizing it, even among friends.
I judge monogamous relationships as inefficient or selfish.
Old jealousies from the harem still haunt my dreams.
I keep score of favors and pleasures owed.
I struggle to form deep bonds with only one partner.

sexualHistories.name: Hedonist
sexualHistories.description: You have lived a life devoted to the unrestrained pursuit of pleasure, chasing every sensation and experience without shame.

traits: Life’s a party and I’m the guest of honor.
I never met a stranger—only lovers I haven’t bedded yet.
I collect stories the way others collect scars.
If it’s worth doing, it’s worth doing loudly.
Tomorrow’s for regrets; tonight is for pleasure.
I live for the moment someone’s eyes light up when they see me.
Rules are for people who don’t know how to have fun.
My reputation arrives ten minutes before I do.

ideals.text: Freedom. No chains, no shame, no regrets.
Joy. The world is better when everyone’s smiling and satisfied.
Legend. I want my name whispered in every tavern from here to the horizon.
Connection. Every body is a new story, every heart a new friend.
Excess. Moderation is for monks.
Selfishness. I’m here for a good time; not for you, just for me.

bonds: There’s one tavern that will always have my back—and my tab running.
A former lover swore they’d kill me if they ever saw me again… worth the risk.
My crew of drinking and bedding buddies would follow me into any party.
I’m searching for the partner who finally made me feel something deeper.
I owe a dangerous crime lord for one too many “free” nights.
My family thinks I’m dead; I like it that way.
flaws: I can’t say no to a pretty face or a dare.
I forget names five minutes after the clothes come off.
I’ll risk everything for one more thrill.
My mouth starts parties my body can’t always finish.
I leave a trail of broken hearts and jealous lovers wherever I go.
Hangovers? What hangovers? I just keep going.

sexualHistories.name: House Servant
sexualHistories.description: You served as a domestic attendant where intimacy was part of your duties — pleasing your master or household discreetly.

traits: I know exactly how my master likes to be touched.
Service is its own kind of intimacy.
I am discreet to a fault.
I take quiet pride in making someone’s day better.
I have learned to read desire in the smallest gestures.
I am loyal, even when it is not returned.
I find satisfaction in being useful.
I hide my own desires behind perfect service.

ideals.text: Duty. A good servant anticipates every need.
Care. Everyone deserves to feel cared for.
Pleasure. Even service can be pleasurable.
Discretion. Some things should never be spoken of.
Ambition. Service is a path to greater things.
Freedom. One day I will serve no one but myself.

bonds: My current master is the only one who truly sees me.
I owe my skills to the person who trained me.
I have a secret lover among the household staff.
I am saving money to buy my freedom.
I fear what will happen if my master discovers my true feelings.
I have sworn to protect the family I serve.
flaws: I sometimes forget my own needs while serving others.
I become jealous when my master favors someone else.
I have difficulty saying no to requests.
I judge other servants harshly if they are sloppy.
I hide my own desires so well that even I forget them.
I fear being replaced.

sexualHistories.name: Indoctrinated
sexualHistories.description: You were raised in a sexually open, free-love society or commune where taboos were minimal and group intimacy was normalized from a young age.

traits: Love is meant to be shared, not hoarded.
I see nothing shameful in pleasure.
I am comfortable with my body and the bodies of others.
Touch is the most honest form of communication.
I judge people by how freely they give and receive pleasure.
I believe jealousy is a poison that destroys joy.
I am open about my desires and expect the same from others.
Sex is celebration, not something to be hidden.

ideals.text: Freedom. No one should be ashamed of their desires.
Community. Pleasure is best when shared with many.
Equality. All bodies and desires are valid.
Openness. Honesty about desire builds stronger bonds.
Joy. Life is too short for repressed pleasure.
Harmony. When everyone is satisfied, the group thrives.

bonds: The commune that raised me is still my true family.
I have many lovers from my upbringing whom I still care for.
I want to create a new community based on the same principles.
I carry the teachings of my mentors in my heart.
I fear returning to a world of shame and repression.
I am searching for others who were raised like I was.
flaws: I sometimes forget that not everyone is as open as I am.
I can be dismissive of monogamous relationships.
I struggle with possessiveness when I care deeply for someone.
I judge people who are sexually repressed.
I have difficulty understanding jealousy.
I can be too casual about intimacy with new people.

sexualHistories.name: Paramour
sexualHistories.description: You were the secret lover — the hidden paramour — of someone powerful, dangerous, or influential. Your relationship was passionate, intense, and almost always concealed from the world.
equipment: Elegant clothing suitable for quick changes
Sensual lingerie that can be worn underneath

traits: I am very good at keeping secrets, to the point of enjoying it.
I will always seize the moment, even if there is great risk in doing so.
I often give hidden signals of my desires and needs.
The danger is almost as thrilling as the touch.
I am loyal to my lover, and only my lover.
The thrill of almost being caught is orgasmic.
My outward facade is a carefully constructed mask that hides my true feelings.
I long for a day when I no longer have to hide who and what I am.

ideals.text: Passion. True desire is always worth the risk.
Loyalty. I will keep my word, even at my own peril.
Secrecy. My feelings, and yours, are too precious to be shared with the world.
Freedom. I yearn only to be able to freely speak my heart.
Power. Intimacy is my favorite path to power over others.
Connection. Hidden love can be greater than any public display.

bonds: My lover’s reputation would be ruined if our relationship were discovered.
I carry a gift from my paramour that I can never be seen wearing openly.
I am still in love with the person I was forbidden to have.
My family would disown me if they knew the truth.
I owe my lover a great debt that goes beyond mere affection.
I fear the day my paramour must choose between me and their duty.
flaws: Jealousy eats me alive when I see my Secret Flame with their public partner.
I put myself in harm's way just for a moment with my lover.
I cannot trust my lover, no matter what they do.
Danger and forbidden love are more romantic to me than a healthy relationship.
I push boundaries that might sabotage my lover's public image just for the thrill of being exposed.
I will go to any lengths to feel useful so that I won't be abandoned.
